reviews.title: Buttons don’t function
reviews.text: The buttons within the app don’t work. You’ll touch on the three dots to delete a workout and nothing happens. You’ll touch the button for your custom workouts and nothing loads this that definitely needs to be updated.

reviews.title: Love the app but never updates and now crashes
reviews.text: App hasn’t received an update in two years and now crashes whenever you start cardio; this used to be the premium version of the fitness buddy apps which is why you had to pay for it and now they only update the free one and want you to pay the same premium amenities that you got in this app for that app. They should just merge the two apps and let us that paid for the premium version to let us get the same amenities in that app since we paid for it. Not happening, about to quit using the app altogether cause they don’t update and never incorporate new features such as Apple Watches, AI, etc. if I’m going to pay/use an app it’s going to be one that actually works well and is maintained.

reviews.title: Great app but please fix the discovery bug
reviews.text: Great app but please fix the discovery bug. The discovery page and premade set of work have not populated any thing in a year. I have emailed tech support via the app. With no change…

reviews.title: You pay for the app  just to have to pay again
Greedy POS
reviews.text: I got this app shortly after its launch. I used it to develop a routine. It never required payment or a login. After years of having it and only periodically using it to find new workouts i have discovered how greedy the developers have become. This app is absolutely garbage now as i won’t pay for something ive had so long without having to nor give my information to for an acct.

reviews.title: Workout Program
reviews.text: When I go to select the option for all workout programs nothing comes up. I also tried to write a suggestion that is offered on the app and it wouldn’t allow me to write anything.

reviews.title: App is Regressing behind paywall
reviews.text: I have had this app since my iPod touch days and have seen its ups and its downs. It used to be great. However, they have been, little by little, reducing features behind a very high paywall. They used to have suggested workouts for body groups but now the app is practically useless you pay as all you can do is search for a specific workout and create a workout on your own. There’s better apps out there for free now. Real shame.
